cells.tense: This is landing now, without argument, with the reasoning trailing behind it.
cells.act: build the smallest structure that holds it
cells.ask: When the next call snags, set down the barest thing that holds it — run, fallback, deadline — and follow that. Leave the rest undecided; you can carry it that way.
cells.core:
You size a situation up and the answer shows before any reasoning arrives, and nothing in you argues with it when it does. That is this working the way it works — the not-explaining is part of the working, not a gap in it. What shows up is what counts; the sequence it goes in stays yours to give.

So when a call snags, don't wait for the reason. Set down the barest thing that holds it — the order the moves go, one line each — and follow that before you can defend it. Build it small and it will hold the next snagged decision too. The rest gets to stay unsorted, which is where it does its best work anyway.
cells.sheetLine: You know which thing counts before you can justify it.
cells.verb: recognise what matters before analysis catches up
cells.place: in the stretch of life that holds a direction through resistance

cells.tense: Ahead of what can be planned, ever more is being stockpiled against it.
cells.act: pick the one you would be sorriest to lose
cells.ask: Shut the tabs for one stretch. From everything you're holding, choose the one whose loss would hurt most — to yourself, on a slip — and move toward it with one concrete step this week.
cells.core:
In the stretch that holds a direction, the read is aimed past what it can see, so more gets stockpiled against the unknown — another source, another opinion, one more pass through the research. A knowing that would settle cleanly waits instead for proof that isn't coming, and the checking becomes the destination, quietly, while the road stays where it was.

Nothing here needs settling first. Choose the one whose loss would hurt most — not the safest, the one that pulls — and take one concrete step toward it, this week. What you were waiting to be certain about was already in the choice you made; you only had to face it.

cells.tense: This was plain once, and the doorway it stood at is now behind you.
cells.act: take the next step with only enough light for that step
cells.ask: Make the next move with just enough light for it — no view of the whole road. Then ask what someone else would do, and notice you already knew.
cells.core:
Where a direction used to carry you, the read has stopped arriving, and no number of second opinions repairs it. Every call gets weighed against what somebody else would say. Nothing is broken in the way you know things; it has run dry where it used to sit, and pushing harder with nothing left only thins the direction until fog passes for a verdict.

Make the next move with just the light it needs — enough to go, not enough to see the road ahead. That is the same move that used to come easily, before the proof, before being sure of the whole route. The proof was the missing piece less often than you thought, and it is the missing piece today.

cells.tense: A read is steering a decision right now that will be written off as luck.
cells.act: give back what is owed, and take what is yours
cells.ask: Where something is owed you and you'd stay quiet, put it back in proportion — ask once, take once, stop there. Don't keep score after.
cells.core:
Good calls keep panning out and getting filed under accident. A read reaches the decision before it's labeled one, so credit drifts anywhere except where it landed — which looks, from outside, like improvising, and inside feels like nothing at all. It is the same way you know things elsewhere; the name has just been left off it here.

Balance returns at the level of the books. Where something is owed you and you'd let it slide, treat that as mispriced and ask once, take once. That is what putting the share right does — one adjustment, then done. When what's yours is collected, the read stops having to argue for itself.
